label: belongs to named corporate family
definition: Company X is explicitly described as belonging to the named corporate family or historical corporate lineage Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit named-family company descriptors such as Bell company; explicit membership in a group of successor companies identified by that corporate lineage; historical corporate-family identification. Excludes: current parent ownership without a family or lineage assertion; ordinary alliance, commercial cooperation or generic association; a company in an industry or geographic place. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear corporate family designation or nominal attachment; a person or incomplete company name replacing the company argument. A corporate-family label is distinct from ownership by a current legal parent. This category does not infer that all family companies are owned by an entity called Y.

facts.reason: U S West → Bell: Explicit Bell-company descriptors establish membership in the named historical corporate family, without asserting ownership by a legal entity called Bell.
